comment: Dr. Telang's class is pretty easy. She goes out of her way to make sure everyone is engaged in class in some way. There are limited assignments during the semester, but she is a tough grader on exams. She looks for highly specific answers.

Aparna takes her class seriously and personally. If a class does poorly on something she feels responsible and will do all she can to help. Her tests are very specific and if you don't answer the exact question you won't get the points. Tough, but nice overall. Don't be late, get on her good side, and you'll be fine.

Dr. Telang is a good lecturer and willing to take student suggestions into consideration. Her test questions can be vague and some people have problems interpreting them, though if you ask her she will help you. Reports are easy, but she can be arbitrarily picky.
